findings.evidence: The §3.5g item 6 amendment (added 2026-05-24) was ratified specifically to close the CompileError::Io→E_UNKNOWN gap at the napi mapNativeError boundary. The closure landed for CompileError::Io (lib.rs:436 routes through ErrorCode::DslIoError; new TS class EDslIoError at errors.generated.ts:3105; CODE_TO_CTOR_GENERATED entry at line 3344). However, the THREE most common DSL error codes — emitted on EVERY parse failure (E_DSL_PARSE_ERROR), unknown-keyword (E_DSL_UNKNOWN_PRIMITIVE), and missing-respond (E_DSL_MISSING_RESPOND) — have IDENTICAL napi-boundary collapse behavior and were NOT closed by the amendment. At lib.rs:426-428 CompileError::code() routes all three through `ErrorCode::Unknown(d.error_code.to_string())`; resolveCtor in errors.ts:386 then misses on the GENERATED map (no entry) and falls through the catalog overlay (no entry) → mapNativeError returns the synthetic E_UNKNOWN wrapper (errors.ts:438-443). Result: every DSL parse / unknown-keyword / missing-respond failure surfaces to JS callers as untyped EUnknown — defeating the EXACT pattern §3.5g item 6 was created to prevent. The amendment text specifies 'EVERY such variant MUST have a corresponding benten_errors::ErrorCode enum entry + full 4-surface mirror'; CompileError::Parse / Semantic / Build all cross a pub fn (compile_str / compile_file public API) AND are constructed in a napi binding return path (compile_err_to_napi) — both trigger conditions met.
findings.fix: Mint FOUR new ErrorCode enum variants in benten_errors (DslParseError / DslUnknownPrimitive / DslMissingRespond + already-exists DslInvalidShape covers the 4th E_DSL_* string emitted by chunk-3); add the full §3.5g 4-surface mirror (Rust enum + as_static_str + from_str + routed_edge_label + TS class in errors.generated.ts + CODE_TO_CTOR_GENERATED entry + ERROR-CATALOG.md narrative + CATALOG_VARIANT_COUNT bump from 194 to 197); update CompileError::code() at lib.rs:426 to route each by matching d.error_code rather than blanket Unknown(_). The scope is identical to the EXISTING chunk-3 #839 / 2026-05-24 §3.5g item 6 amendment patches that landed for Io + Backend — pattern-matched, low-cognitive-overhead, dispatch-conventions §3.5g compliant.

findings.title: EDslIoError + EDslBackendRejected TS classes not re-exported from packages/engine/src/errors.ts — undiscoverable as named imports from `@benten/engine/errors`
where: packages/engine/src/errors.ts:14-94 (the named re-export block from './errors.generated.js') — EDslInvalidShape (line 34) + EDslUnregisteredHandler (line 35) ARE re-exported; EDslIoError + EDslBackendRejected are NOT

packages/engine/src/errors.generated.ts:3105 (export class EDslIoError — defined but unforwarded)
packages/engine/src/index.ts:8 ('Typed errors live in @benten/engine/errors (sibling subpath export)' — the subpath comment confirms errors.ts is the canonical user-facing surface)
findings.evidence: Consumers writing `import { EDslIoError } from '@benten/engine/errors'` will get an import error at TypeScript compile time because errors.ts does NOT re-export the class. The class CAN still be reached via `CODE_TO_CTOR_GENERATED['E_DSL_IO_ERROR']` (errors.generated.ts:3344) OR via direct deep-import from the generated file (`import { EDslIoError } from '@benten/engine/dist/errors.generated'`) — but neither path is the documented public surface. The runtime resolveCtor path at errors.ts:386-390 DOES route through CODE_TO_CTOR_GENERATED so `mapNativeError(napiError)` still returns the correctly-typed instance — i.e. `result instanceof EDslIoError` works at runtime IF the consumer has imported the class via the deep-import workaround. But the named-import (TypeScript-checked) path through `@benten/engine/errors` does not surface either class, breaking the symmetry with EDslInvalidShape + EDslUnregisteredHandler. Per V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE item 10 (TS/JS @benten/engine public API frozen): 'The exported TS class/type/function names are locked' — what is NOT re-exported at freeze time is what stays NOT re-exported.
findings.fix: Add `EDslBackendRejected,` and `EDslIoError,` to BOTH the `export { ... }` block at errors.ts:14-94 AND the import block at errors.ts:96-180 (so resolveCtor's hand-curated CODE_TO_CTOR overlay can include explicit mappings if desired, mirroring the existing EDslInvalidShape pattern at line 218). Two-line addition; mechanical. Sibling check: confirm the same pattern at the future #1204 JS-side public-api baseline regen (the ts-public-api.yml workflow) captures the new exports.
